thread:
Maya Singh: Heads up team — POC customer signed under our old v2 ratecard (sku: poc-ded-10). Release v4 consolidated skus and the equivalent now requires a 3x min commit. Customer is mid-POC and asking us to honor the original price. Thoughts?
Ethan Brooks: Can we treat as a one-off concession? Finance will want a ticket + GL code. No retroactive ARR unless exec signs off.
Nina Gomez: Legal: ok to approve as a temporary exception if sales adds an amendment stating non-precedential and effective on approval date. No backdating.
Carlos Vega: Product: sku consolidation was deliberate for capacity forecasts. We should add a compatibility alias in quoting so this repeats less.
deal-desk-bot: Created ticket DD-2199. Please upload the SOW and requested effective window.
Maya Singh: Uploaded SOW and customer acceptance. They want legacy pricing for the remaining 28 days.
Ethan Brooks: Finance: we can do a prorated credit from approval date and label it POC-ADJ-2026. Need ARR impact estimate in the ticket.
Nina Gomez: I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum and attach to DD-2199.
Carlos Vega: I'll open a short internal kb note: "sku-compatibility-mapping" and link it in the ticket.
Maya Singh: If all approvals in place I can notify the customer by EOD. Please mark DD-2199 APPROVED once addendum is signed.
deal-desk-bot: DD-2199 status: AWAITING_ADENDUM_UPLOAD.
_meta: generated for dataset: slack sales thread about POC legacy pricing exception and internal approvals
